notes.title: Steam Digital Tabletop Sale 2021
notes.content:
Slitherine is taking part in the [b]Steam Digital Tabletop Sale 2021[/b].

A number of Slitherine games are now on sale, until October 25. if you are looking for digital tabletop and boardgames, look no further!

Conflict of Heroes: Awakening the Bear - 75% off 
Conflict of Heroes: Storm of Steel - 67% off
Conflict of Heroes: Ghost Divisions -  67% off
Drive on Moscow - 51% off
Heroes of Normandie - 75% off
FIeld of Glory II - 75% off
Field of Glory II: Medieval - 30% off
Last Days of Old Earth - 75% off
Magnifico - 90% off
Valor & Victory - 15% off
Victory & Glory Napoleon - 75% off

If you'd like to take advantage of an additional discount, check these two bundles out:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/6500/Field_of_Glory_II_Complete/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/21575/Tabletop_Wargames/

You can find the whole catalogue on sale [url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?sort_by=_ASC&specials=1&publisher=Slitherine+Ltd.]here[/url].

The offer is valid until October 25 10 am PST.
